title: Spec
description: One change: what, why, how it is proven, who approves it. Stored as TOML front matter in specs/<id>.md; the Markdown body holds Context, Acceptance, Design, and Non-goals.

approvers.description: Eligible Approvers for this Spec. Can only narrow the config's `owners.approvers`.

route.description: normal (the gate raises it to major when the diff demands it), major, or emergency for a backfill Spec. Minor and standard changes have no Spec file.

trace_id.description: Joins the Specs and changes of one piece of work across repositories. Defaults to the id.

status.description: Optional bookkeeping; the gate derives the state from the PR/MR.

blocked_on.description: Role, person, or interface the Spec waits on. Required when status is blocked.

proposed_by.description: Who proposed work nobody asked for: `agent:<role>` for an agent in `[agents] proactive_roles` (or an agent account). Such a Spec stays a draft until a person records `triage`.

triage.description: A person's decision on proposed work. Required, by a person, before a Spec whose proposed_by is an agent moves past draft.

rollback.description: How to undo. Name the steps on major and emergency.

hypothesis.description: The measurable result the change should produce after Ship, written before Spec approval and frozen by the approval hash: a metric, its baseline, the expected move, and by when. Learn records `outcome.result` against it.

residual_risk.description: What stays true after release. `none` when nothing remains.

decisions.description: ADR paths or links this Spec depends on.

tasks.description: Slices of the change. Parallel only when their scope is disjoint.

files.description: Mockups, wireframes, and flows a human approves at Spec approval with the Spec, such as `docs/design/SPEC-220/**`. Frozen by the Spec hash like the tests: never implementation scope.

design.description: The approved look and flow of a user-facing change. Optional; the product designer writes it before Spec approval.

observe.description: Post-release check. Required on the profile's observe_required_routes: major, and normal under regulated.

outcome.description: What happened after Ship. Written during the observe window and in Learn.

scope.description: Globs this Task's diff may change. Never a test or design file, never a catch-all.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must finish first. Required between Tasks whose scope overlaps.

skills.description: Skills loaded only for this Task, by directory name: a practice skill such as `api-design` or a stack skill, at most two. Domain packs are named in Context instead.

risk.description: What this Task could break, and how it guards against it. Approved content: frozen by the Spec approval hash.

proof.description: How this Task is shown to work: the test command, screenshot, or check a reviewer reads. Approved content: frozen by the Spec approval hash.

retry_count.description: Implementation retries used. At 3 the Spec is blocked.

restored_at.description: Date service was restored after a failed change (a rollback or a fix). With `released_at`, it gives the time to restore.

learn_ref.description: Link to the retro or the PR that fed lessons back into AGENTS.md, skills, or tests.

result.description: What the metric named in `hypothesis` did after the observe window: met, missed, or inconclusive, with the number. A missed hypothesis is a Learn signal for the author and the product-manager, not a rollback.

outcome.description: What happened after Ship. Written during the observe window and in Learn; never part of the approval hash.

decision.description: accepted: the work goes ahead. declined: it does not (set the status to cancelled). duplicate: another item carries it (name it in duplicate_of). snoozed: decide again on `until`; `aidd next` hides it until then.

by.description: The person who decided. Never an agent or an agent account: `aidd validate` fails one.

until.description: Snoozed only: the date the item comes back for a decision.

duplicate_of.description: Duplicate only: the item that carries the work.

triage.description: A person's decision on work an agent proposed: accepted, declined, duplicate, or snoozed, with who and when.
